corrections.correction: Eq. (5) prints (2 pi)^(-3/2) although the covariance and residual are 3N dimensional; normalized density requires (2 pi)^(-3N/2). Keep the printed source and reviewer repair separate. An identical dimension-only factor cancels between models at the same cut, so this alone cannot reverse the Bayes ratio. The inspected m2loglike implements 3*N*ln(2*pi).

corrections.correction: The paper prose and Luna use z/D_FP. This has inverse-length units, not km/s/Mpc, unless c is included. In H_i/mean(H_i), c cancels, so the dimensionless relative diagnostic is consistent. Do not present unnormalized z/D as an absolute Hubble measurement.

The alternative is Millennium late-time LambdaCDM structure plus an empirical deformation with b_soft=0.75, not self-consistent timescape. Table 2 reports binned discrepancies 1.52 sigma in LG and 2.08 sigma in CMB; rounded slopes/scatter are coherent. Overlapping bins are correlated. The 64 ordered mock pairs reuse eight underlying regions and 36 unique combinations. KS fits are poor for both families, and the authors question implementation/suitability. They explicitly state current data/models cannot fully exclude timescape.
locators: Section 4.4, PDF pp.6-7; Section 5.1, PDF p.8; Sections 5.3-5.5, Table 2, PDF pp.10-12; Sections 6.7-7, PDF pp.15-18

corrections.correction: From a=abar/gamma and dt/dtau=gamma, the chain rule gives H=gamma Hbar-dgamma/dt. H uses wall proper time tau, Hbar volume-average time t. Eq. (3) averages volume shares in t; Eq. (13) interpolates empirical line fractions in observer time. The latter does not automatically satisfy the former. A negatively curved sphere exceeds Euclidean volume at fixed proper radial/geodesic radius; radius conventions matter. This supports a missing proxy-fidelity contract, not a unique object-level prediction, observational confirmation or proof that every nonlinear deformation fails. Quoted CMB/H values remain attributed prior fits.
locators: Eqs. (1)-(13), PDF pp.2-3; Section 4, PDF p.4
